audit_items.proof_trace: is_obligation_safe (L1214) computes collateral_weighted_value = Σ(collateral_USD × emode_collateral_factor) and borrow_weighted_value = Σ(debt_USD × borrow_weight), asserting collateral_weighted ≥ borrow_weighted after every debt-increasing (handle_borrow L434) and collateral-decreasing (handle_withdraw L342) operation. Emode asset membership is enforced at deposit time (handle_mint L297) and borrow time (handle_borrow L400) via borrow_mut_emode asserts, preventing cross-group collateral or debt. Admin constraints (emode_admin.move L178) enforce borrow_weight ≥ 1.0, ensuring the health check is always meaningful.
